DIAGNOSIS READY: Pemphigus Vulgaris.

I have noted the biopsy results showing acantholysis and the specific presence of desmoglein antibodies, which confirm an autoimmune blistering disease. The normal viral, bacterial, and inflammatory markers further rule out infections like cellulitis, herpes, or systemic vasculitis. I will now monitor your response to treatment.
